# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5225

# Review — PAN-5225
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — CI test-shard (4/4) is red on this HEAD: three `tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts` closeOut cases still assert the old local-`main` fallback that FR-2 replaced (also: AC 5 fourth test missing)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5225-review-a00fa474
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5225/.pan/review/agent-pan-5225-review-a00fa474/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5225 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5225
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5240
- HEAD reviewed: a00fa474deef7996c25bc8e6e639ff5361462ca6
- Base / prior cycle SHA: origin/main cbd344564b5 (merge-base); no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness / validation] FR-2 broke three existing closeOut tests, and CI's test job is red — `tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts:693`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (test suite not updated for an intended behavior change); in_pr_scope. It also violates NFR-5 ("Existing row texts and DoD tests stay green except the two `verify-merged-remote-target` cases whose fixtures FR-2 changes"). The spec under-counted the affected tests, but the branch had to keep the suite green either way.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `resolveTargetComparison()` in `src/lib/lifecycle/verify-merged.ts` now runs `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/main^{commit}` after a failed fetch, before it tries local `main`. These three tests mock `execAsync`:
  1. `falls back to local main and notes it in details when the fetch fails but the branch is merged` (line 693)
  2. `fails with the local-fallback note in parentheses when the fetch fails and the branch is unmerged` (line 726)
  3. `fails before any git comparison when the fetch fails and no local target branch exists` (line 764)

  The default branch of the mock in tests 1 and 2 returns `{ stdout: '' }` for unmatched commands. So the new remote-tracking `rev-parse` "resolves", the code picks `origin/main`, and the note and comparison ref change. Test 3 expects the old error text `... and no local main branch exists`. The new text is `... and neither origin/main nor a local main branch exists`.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected: a green CI test job. Observed: CI run 43556169788 on a00fa474, job `test-shard (4/4)`, reports `Test Files 1 failed | 655 passed`. The failures are:
  - `AssertionError: expected [ 'All commits merged to main', …(1) ] to deeply equal …`
  - `expected true to be false`
  - `expected 'Cannot verify merge: git fetch origin…' to be …`

  The aggregate `test` check also fails. The PR cannot merge while this job is red.
- Evidence: `gh pr checks 5240` shows the failures, and `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/actions/jobs/132329392839/logs` shows the failing test names above. Static trace: the mock defaults at workflows.test.ts lines 707 and 744, and line 771 throws for any command it does not list. That makes `refResolves` return false in test 3, so only its expected string is stale.
- Fix: this is a test-only change. Production behavior matches FR-2.
  - In tests 1 and 2, make `git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/main^{commit}` throw, so the local-`main` fallback (step 2 of FR-2) is still covered. Then add the mirror case, where the remote-tracking ref resolves and the comparison runs against `origin/main` with the `last-fetched` note, or rely on the real-git fixture in `verify-merged-remote-target.test.ts`, which covers it.
  - In test 3, update the expected error to `Cannot verify merge: git fetch origin main failed (fatal: unable to access origin) and neither origin/main nor a local main branch exists`.
  - A repo-wide grep (`Checked against local`, `no local .* branch exists`) over `tests/`, `src/`, `frontend/` and `docs/` finds no other stale assertion. The remaining hits are the production note in `verify-merged.ts:52`, the intended local-fallback case at `verify-merged-remote-target.test.ts:150`, and the updated MERGE-WORKFLOW text.
  - Rerun `npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts`.

### [requirements] AC 5 unmet: WI-5's fourth test was not written as specified — `tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts:1357`
- Severity: ! MUST (an explicit in-scope acceptance criterion is unmet; there is no current product defect)
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap; in_pr_scope (AC 5: "passes, including the four new cases").
- WI-5 asks for `evaluateDodGate reads forge landing once across rows 1, 2 and 5`, using **the real `checkPostMergeRow` wiring** with stubbed post-merge deps. The branch instead extended the existing PAN-5209 test with a stub `postMerge`. That stub calls `landing.forgeMerge()` itself, so nothing exercises the default `defaultEvaluateDodGateDeps.postMerge` wiring, `(ctx, merged, landing) => checkPostMergeRow(ctx, merged, undefined, landing)`. The PRD calls out exactly this wiring as a pitfall: a bare reference would put `landing` into the `deps` slot.
- By inspection the wiring in `src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts:264` is correct. The live probe in `.pan/drafts/PAN-5225-live-probe.md` also shows that row 5 receives the forge verdict through the real path (MIN-1140 and MIN-1139 both print `post-merge: pass — … forge merge complete …`). So there is no current product defect. The missing piece is the regression guard that AC 5 requires.
- Fix: add the specified `evaluateDodGate` test. Use a non-GitHub ctx and a `forgeMerge` spy, leave `postMerge` as the default (real `checkPostMergeRow` wiring), stub only the row 5 dependencies, and assert that the spy is called exactly once and that row 5 observed contains `forge merge complete`. If you cannot stub the default post-merge deps from `evaluateDodGate`, ask the operator to accept the probe in place of this test and amend AC 5.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] Row 5's miss text omits a non-complete forge verdict — `src/lib/lifecycle/dod-post-merge-row.ts:600`
- Severity: ? MAY
- When forge evidence is `incomplete` or `unverifiable`, the row falls through to `canonical state unavailable; PR mergedAt: not merged; …` and does not say why the forge read did not count. This is what FR-5 asks for ("Any other verdict leaves today's result and text unchanged"), so it is not a defect. Adding `verdict.text` would help an operator diagnose a MYN close-out miss. That would be a spec change for a follow-up.

### [requirements] The first post-merge reload may not rewrite the shim yet
- Severity: ? MAY (unconfirmed hypothesis)
- `pan reload` runs from the CLI that is installed when you invoke it. The first reload after this merge therefore runs the old `reportCliRepoint`, which repoints only the npm-global link. The shell `pan` may stay on the old generation until a launcher, `pan sync` or a second reload rewrites the shim. The probe file's plan, "real `pan close MIN-1140 --force` runs after merge and `pan reload`", could then still run the old close-out code. Not verified: I did not check whether reload re-execs into the new build. Fix: before the real close, run `pan sync` or a second `pan reload` and confirm that `~/.overdeck/cli-bin/pan` names the new deploy root.

### Pre-existing / out of scope (noted only)
- Shell interpolation of `sourceBranch` and `targetBranch` into `exec` strings in `dod-forge-merge.ts` and `verify-merged.ts` is pre-existing. The new `addsNoChanges` and `refResolves` follow the same pattern, and the values come from project config and issue IDs, which are trusted local inputs under the threat model. No new exposure.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
| File | Status |
| --- | --- |
| src/cli/commands/reload.ts | Reviewed. `reportCliRepoint` now runs the npm-global repoint and then `writePanCliShims({ root: deployRoot })`, and returns the link error first, then the shim error. All four call sites checked (superseded-but-live, gate-not-proceed, leaves-dashboard-running, which ignores the error as before, and success). The shim is not touched on the rollback paths, as the test at line 745 asserts. The `PanCliShimWriteResult` statuses are handled exhaustively. Correct. |
| src/lib/lifecycle/dod-forge-merge.ts | Reviewed. `addsNoChanges` uses `git diff --quiet ref...tip`: exit 0 means no-branch-work, exit 1 means unlanded, and any other error is rethrown to the outer catch, giving unverifiable. Node `exec` error `.code` is the exit status, so this works. `no-branch-work` never counts as merged in `readForgeMergeVerdict`, so completeness still needs a merged artifact. Matches FR-4 and D4. |
| src/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.ts | Reviewed. Row 5 code removed, with a re-export of `checkPostMergeRow` and `readPullRequestMergedAt` for existing importers. `postMerge` deps signature and default wiring now pass `undefined` deps and `landing`. The call site passes `landing`. 856 lines (NFR-1). |
| src/lib/lifecycle/dod-post-merge-row.ts | Reviewed. The extraction is the old row 5 copied verbatim, plus the FR-5 block, which runs after the strike and branch-containment branches only when `!lifecycleObserved && landing?.forgeMerge`. `forgeMerge` exists only for non-GitHub ctx and is memoized, so there is no extra forge read. Imports are leaves only. It does not import dod-gate (NFR-2). `PostMergeMergedEvidence` is a structural subset of `MergedDodRowResult`, and typecheck passes on CI. |
| src/lib/lifecycle/dod.ts | Reviewed. `dodRowDefinition` and `dodRowResult` moved here verbatim. |
| src/lib/lifecycle/verify-merged.ts | Reviewed. The fallback order is now origin/<target>, then local <target>, then error, with notes as in FR-3. Only `verifyConventionBranchMerged`, the remote-branch check, and `assessRepoLanding` call it. `assessRepoLanding` still treats any note as unverifiable (D3, non-goal 3 kept). This is the root cause of the blocking test failures. |
| src/cli/commands/__tests__/reload.test.ts | Reviewed. The shim module is mocked (NFR-4). Adds the success assertion and a failure test (`EACCES`, then exitCode 1). The rollback test asserts no shim write. |
| src/cli/commands/__tests__/reload-health-timeout.integration.test.ts | Reviewed. Shim mock added. |
| tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-forge-merge.test.ts | Reviewed. Real-git cases (f), (g) and (h) cover no changes, main advancing, and real changes. |
| tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/dod-gate.test.ts | Reviewed. Three new row 5 cases. The fourth WI-5 case was substituted (advisory above). |
| tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/verify-merged-remote-target.test.ts | Reviewed. Real-git fixtures for both last-fetched cases, plus the local fallback and the error path with `update-ref -d`. |
| docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md, docs/BUILD.md | Reviewed. They describe the fallback order, the protected-branch assumption (D3a), the no-change rule, and reload as a shim writer. They match the code. |
| changelog.d/pan-5225.md | Reviewed. `#### Fixed`, two entries. |
| .overdeck/context/codebase/concerns.md | Reviewed. Shim note added. |
| .pan/drafts/PAN-5225.md, -critique.md, -critique-2.md, -live-probe.md | Reviewed (planning artifacts and probe evidence). |
| .pan/continues/PAN-5225.xbrief.json, .pan/specs/…PAN-5225….xbrief.json | Not applicable for code review (plan artifacts). Skimmed via the PRD traces only. |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** the production logic for FR-1, FR-2, FR-4 and FR-5 is correct as traced. The blocker is stale tests in an unchanged test file that exercises the changed `resolveTargetComparison`.
- **Security:** no new trust boundary. The git ref interpolation follows the existing pattern with trusted config inputs. Shim writes use atomic tmp-then-rename (pre-existing writer).
- **Performance:** adds one `git rev-parse` after a failed fetch and one `git diff --quiet` per off-main repo. These are bounded and negligible. The forge read stays memoized, one per close-out.
- **Requirements / UX:** see the matrix. Row 3 is untouched, no `pan close` was run, the Linear state is not read, and the allowlist and circular baseline are not edited. All non-goals are respected.

### Acceptance criteria
| AC | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 (WI-1 reload tests) | met | No CI shard failed either reload suite: shard 4's only failing file is workflows.test.ts, and shards 1–3 passed. Which shard ran each suite was not checked. The success assertion checks `writePanCliShims({ root })`. |
| 2 (WI-2 verify-merged fixtures) | met for the named file, but the change breaks workflows.test.ts | The named suite is green on CI. The blocker above is a regression in a sibling suite. |
| 3 (WI-3 no-change branch) | met | Cases (f), (g) and (h). |
| 4 (WI-4 extraction, ≤1000 lines, lint, typecheck) | met | `wc -l` gives 856. `lint`, all four `lint-group` jobs and `build (22)` pass on a00fa474. `lint:circular` and `lint:file-size` run in `lint-group (core)`, per `scripts/run-lint-group.mjs` (any step not in HEAVY_STEPS goes to core) and the `lint` script in package.json. `overdeck/verification` (typecheck+lint) passed. |
| 5 (WI-5 four new cases) | **unmet** | Three new cases. The fourth was substituted with a stub `postMerge` (blocking finding 2). |
| 6 (WI-6 docs) | met | MERGE-WORKFLOW contains `last-fetched` and `adds no changes`. BUILD.md names `pan reload`. The changelog entry exists. `lint:docs` runs in `lint-group (core)`, which is green. |
| 7 (WI-7 live probe) | met | `.pan/drafts/PAN-5225-live-probe.md`: MIN-1140 shows `passed true`. MIN-1139 shows the expected rows with `verification: miss`, and its prerequisite is stated. |
| FR-1…FR-6 | implemented | Traced above. FR-6 evidence is the probe file. |
| NFR-1/2/3/4 | met | 856 lines. Leaf-only imports, and lint-group core is green. No execSync. Shim mocked in tests, and real-git fixtures used. |
| NFR-5 | **unmet** | Existing workflows.test.ts closeOut cases went red (blocker). |

## Verification
- `gh pr checks 5240` on HEAD a00fa474 (run 43556169788): `test-shard (4/4)` **fail** (workflows.test.ts, 3 tests), aggregate `test` **fail**. Shards 1–3, test-e2e, build (22), lint, all lint-groups (core, effect, skills, state), the clean install smoke test and integrations **pass**. bare-host-linux/macos and the non-blocking flake lane were still pending.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: covered by the green `lint-group (effect)` job on this exact HEAD. The mapping is in `scripts/run-lint-group.mjs:16`. Not rerun.
- `overdeck/verification`: passed (typecheck+lint; tests deferred to CI).
- Job log read through `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/actions/jobs/132329392839/logs`.
- No local test runs. The failing tests and their cause were confirmed from the CI log and a static trace of the mocks.

## Scope Note
NFR-5 in the PRD listed only the two `verify-merged-remote-target` cases as expected test changes. It missed the three PAN-5209 `closeOut` cases in `tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts` that pin the same fallback. The work agent should update those tests, not revert FR-2.
